mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 7 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 3.

Democrats win deep victory in US midterm elections, taking control of Congress, while Republicans suffer historic losses.

Albania will receive €213 million from the EU Growth Plan, with implementation already at 90% according to Gert Jan Koopman.

Cristiano Ronaldo, now 41, has cemented his place among the greatest international footballers, setting new records for appearances and goals.

Kosovo's University Clinical Center reported the first public-sector birth resulting from assisted reproductive technology.

Greek newspaper Protothema alleges that a 49-year-old Albanian leader ordered grenade attacks on businesses in Athens from inside the Trikala prison.
